function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on whether you’re looking for something local or something that can be delivered right to your doorstep: | Option | What it offers | How to order | |--------|----------------|--------------| | **Local bakeries** | Fresh, custom‑made cakes, often with a personal touch. | Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp, call the bakery, or visit their website. Many local shops now accept online orders via their own site or through platforms like **Etsy** or **Shopify**. | | **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, a wide range of flavors, and sometimes same‑day service. | • **Goldbelly** – delivers specialty cakes from famous bakeries across the U.S.
• **Cake Delivery** – offers a variety of cakes and custom orders.
• **Amazon Fresh** – has a selection of cakes from local vendors in many cities. | | **Subscription boxes** | Monthly cake deliveries, often themed or seasonal. | • **The Cake Box** – delivers a fresh cake each month.
• **Cratejoy** – hosts several cake subscription services. | | **Custom cake makers on Etsy** | Hand‑crafted, personalized designs. | Search “custom cake” on Etsy, choose a seller with good reviews, and place your order through the platform. | | **Big‑box grocery stores** | Convenient, often same‑day pickup or delivery. | • **Walmart Grocery** – offers a selection of cakes for pickup or delivery.
• **Kroger** – has a “Bakery” section on their app for ordering. | | **Specialty dessert shops** | Unique flavors, artisanal ingredients. | Look up “artisan cake shop” or “dessert boutique” in your city. Many have websites or Instagram pages where you can place orders. | ### Quick steps to place an order online 1. **Choose a platform** (e.g., Goldbelly, Amazon Fresh, local bakery website). 2. **Select your cake** – pick flavor, size, and any custom text or decorations. 3. **Add to cart** – fill in delivery details (address, time window). 4. **Pay** – most sites accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay. 5. **Confirm** – you’ll receive an email confirmation and tracking info if applicable. If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up specific bakeries or delivery options that are available in your area!
